items.title: The Chicks join Jason Isbell's class action against Suno, as amended complaint adds 16 plaintiffs and targets v6
items.excerpt: An amended complaint filed in Boston federal court on Nov 24 adds 16 plaintiffs - The Chicks, Carl Craig, David Longstreth, Phil Elverum, Ezra Furman and others - to Isbell's proposed class action against Suno, with right-of-publicity claims in 14 states plus Illinois BIPA and new allegations covering Suno v6.

items.title: Musixmatch launches enhanced Pro for Artists platform with lyric merch sales and 'optional AI licensing coming soon'
items.excerpt: Musixmatch relaunched Pro for Artists with fan-engagement analytics and lyric merch, and flagged an opt-in AI licensing option for artists' lyrics as coming soon. AI component is announced, not yet shipped.

items.title: The AI revolution is coming for your electronic instruments
items.excerpt: MusicRadar feature: 'a new era of AI-assisted modding has arrived' for hardware instruments; Elektron and Akai discuss the opportunities and challenges as users apply AI coding tools to their gear.

history_match.title: Akai is embracing vibe-coded mods with an open-source MPC

items.title: Audiotool Integrates Google Flow Music, Lets Users Play Vibe-Coded Instruments Together in a Browser DAW
items.excerpt: Browser DAW Audiotool now hosts instruments and effects built in Google Flow Music's Spaces via its new NXS plugin system, with real-time multiplayer, MIDI mapping and automation; available now.

items.title: 대음협, AI 음원에 "책임 있는 학습·가수 보호·공정 유통을"
items.excerpt: Korea's music industry association (대음협) surveyed 14 member labels (83.4% of top-100 album sales): none back unconditional TDM exemptions or 'use first, pay later'; 100% want stronger publicity rights; 9 of 14 already have fraud-liability clauses in distribution contracts. It issued three AI policy principles.

items.title: '5인조 AI 보이그룹' 히어러스, 'CRUSH'로 가요계 출사표
items.excerpt: AI entertech firm KAIVERSE debuted five-member AI boy group H3ARUS with disco pop-funk single 'CRUSH' and an official music video on Korean streaming services on Nov 23. Off-list (khan.co.kr); different act from SEORIA.

items.title: 폴킴, 뮤비 감독으로 데뷔했다···주연배우는 'AI'
items.excerpt: Singer Paul Kim directed the animated music video for his Nov 27 English single 'My Only One', starring an AI character; the 2m58s video was rated by the Korea Media Rating Board on Nov 24. AI role in production thinly described — verify.

items.title: 팬과 대화하는 AI, 찍지도 않은 뮤직비디오···아이돌의 얼굴·목소리는 누구의 것인가

items.title: Kate Bush and Grace Jones urge Australian government not to legalise AI 'theft'
items.excerpt: Kate Bush, Grace Jones and Ian Rankin joined 7,000 artists and creatives urging Australia's Labor government not to weaken copyright law for AI training, after a parliamentary AI committee proposed reforms.

items.title: Aussie MPs' new AI proposals "disguise" pro-big tech copyright reforms as "a favour to creators", says ARIA boss
items.excerpt: An Australian parliamentary AI select committee report proposes copyright reforms to give AI companies 'certainty'; ARIA accuses MPs of gaslighting and says no reform is needed. Same cluster as the Guardian item.

items.title: The amp modeler world's biggest disruptor has launched a DIY pedal kit that hosts NAM A2 captures
items.excerpt: TONE3000 and Daisy Audio launched a roughly $78 DIY pedal kit on the Seed3 module that runs Neural Amp Modeler (NAM) A2 neural captures, stacks them and pairs them with impulse responses.

history_match.title: Heritage Audio's i73 Pro gains NAM A2 support

items.title: Spotify Strengthens Anti-Deepfake Artist Profile Protections; Now Available to All Artists
items.excerpt: Spotify clarified that Artist Profile Protection, its control against AI deepfakes and misattributed uploads, is now available to all artists after a gradual rollout and beta. Follow-up to the 11-18 launch card.

history_match.title: Spotify's new tool aims to stop deepfakes from being attributed to real artists

items.title: IncrementDET: Continual AI-Generated Music Detection via Enrollment
items.excerpt: A detector that learns each new AI music generator by 'enrollment' - adding one linear classifier per generator against human reference tracks - so platforms can catch unseen generators without retraining a universal model.

items.title: MADlibs: Analyzing the Distribution of Generative Music
items.excerpt: A framework measuring what text-to-music models actually produce across prompt space (key, tempo, instrumentation, dynamics); finds models are not interchangeable and each has idiosyncratic limits on reachable music.

items.title: 전문 작곡가들도 AI 활용…"거대한 흐름 같이 타야"
items.excerpt: KBS report on professional Korean composers adopting AI for melody and vocal production after an AI-sung song topped domestic charts. Off-list broadcaster.

items.title: 뮤잇, AI 음악 마스터링 서비스 '헤이웨이브' 누적 처리 1만 1000곡 돌파
items.excerpt: Muit's AI mastering service heywavv, built to clean harsh highs in Suno-generated tracks for commercial release, passed 1,000 users and 11,000 processed songs a month after launch. Off-list, likely press-release.

items.excerpt: Vienna developer Marian Moritz Hildebrand built Truffle, a Mac app that uses AI to repair chaotic music collections' metadata, sold with one-time pricing. Off-list.
